lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: When did he take the jeep down?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Well he told me he was gonna take it at nighttime.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: 10:00 o'clock is nighttime. What do you mean by nighttime?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: He said after the fire would go down he would take it down to the pit and then at that time I was at home.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: He's over, he's, he slept over by his friend's house.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: How much blood did you have on you?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: What about your hands? (pause) What about your hands?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Show me again. Grab, take this pen like it's the knife, OK. Tell me how you stabbed her and how hard you stabbed her. Right here. (Mark demonstrates) I mean, how
